name: OpenTelemetry
description: Receive OTLP traces, metrics and logs, then browse span waterfalls and analyze them with SQL through DBX's built-in DuckDB.

contributions.label: OpenTelemetry receiver
contributions.description: Runs OTLP/HTTP and OTLP/gRPC ingest endpoints inside the plugin sidecar and stores traces, metrics and logs as JSONL plus DuckDB-readable CSV.

fields.label: Listen host
fields.description: Use 127.0.0.1 for local apps; 0.0.0.0 exposes the endpoint to your network.

fields.label: HTTP port
fields.description: OTLP/HTTP default is 4318. If the port is taken, DBX falls back to an ephemeral port and shows the real one.

fields.label: gRPC port
fields.description: OTLP/gRPC default is 4317. Set 0 to disable gRPC and keep only the HTTP endpoint.

fields.label: Retention days
fields.description: Data files older than this are removed on connect and on demand.

fields.label: Ingest token
fields.description: Optional. When set, send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or 'X-OTLP-Token'.

contributions.label: OpenTelemetry
contributions.description: Receiver status, trace waterfall, metrics and logs, plus ready-to-run DuckDB SQL over the stored files.

contributions.label: Trace waterfall
contributions.description: Renders a query result that contains trace/span columns as a span waterfall.

zh-CN.name: OpenTelemetry 遥测
zh-CN.description: 接收 OTLP 链路、指标与日志，查看 span 瀑布图，并通过 DBX 内置 DuckDB 用 SQL 分析。

com.yiqiui.otel.receiver.label: OpenTelemetry 接收端
com.yiqiui.otel.receiver.description: 在插件 Sidecar 内运行 OTLP/HTTP 与 OTLP/gRPC 接收端，把链路、指标、日志存为 JSONL 与可供 DuckDB 读取的 CSV。

listen_host.label: 监听地址
listen_host.description: 本机应用填 127.0.0.1；填 0.0.0.0 会把接收端暴露到局域网。

listen_port.label: HTTP 端口
listen_port.description: OTLP/HTTP 默认 4318。端口被占用时会自动改用随机端口，并显示真实端口。

grpc_port.label: gRPC 端口
grpc_port.description: OTLP/gRPC 默认 4317。填 0 表示只开 HTTP 接收端，不额外占用端口。

retention_days.label: 保留天数
retention_days.description: 超过该天数的数据文件会在连接时与手动清理时删除。

ingest_token.label: 上报令牌
ingest_token.description: 可选。设置后需以 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 或 'X-OTLP-Token' 头发送。

com.yiqiui.otel.workbench.label: OpenTelemetry 遥测
com.yiqiui.otel.workbench.description: 接收端状态、链路瀑布图、指标与日志，以及可直接执行的 DuckDB 分析 SQL。

com.yiqiui.otel.waterfall.label: 链路瀑布图
com.yiqiui.otel.waterfall.description: 把包含 trace/span 字段的查询结果渲染成 span 瀑布图。
